description: Get the Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) for all integrations configured in this tenant. Returns algorithm coverage, PQC migration status (quantum-safe / hybrid / classical-only / unknown), and remediation priority for each connector. Use this to identify which systems still use classical-only cryptography and are at risk from 'Harvest Now, Decrypt Later' attacks.

format.description: Response format: full JSON or executive summary (default: json)

name: get_cbom
